types.name: Triangles
types.description: Asks for the area, height, side, perimeter, inradius or circumradius of a triangle (scalene, right, isosceles or equilateral), often from three sides (Heron) or two sides and an angle.

types.name: Quadrilaterals and polygons
types.description: Asks for the area, perimeter, side or diagonal of a rectangle, square, parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, kite or regular polygon such as a hexagon, including fencing or tiling cost.

types.name: Circles, rings and wheels
types.description: Asks for the circumference or area of a circle, semicircle, quadrant or circular ring, revolutions of a wheel, or shapes inscribed in or around a circle.

types.name: Sectors and segments
types.description: Mentions a sector, arc length, central angle, minor or major segment, or the area swept by a clock hand or a pendulum.

types.name: Paths and borders
types.description: Asks for the area or cost of a path, border, verandah, crossroads or frame of given width running inside, outside or across a rectangle, square or circle.

types.name: Cubes and cuboids
types.description: Asks for the volume, surface area, area of four walls, diagonal or edge of a cube, cuboid, room, box or brick, or the number of small cubes or bricks that fit.

types.name: Cylinders
types.description: Asks for the volume, curved or total surface area of a solid or hollow cylinder, pipe, roller, well or tank shaped like a cylinder.

types.name: Cones and frustums
types.description: Asks for the slant height, volume or surface area of a cone, a tent, a bucket or a frustum, or a cone formed by folding a sector.

types.name: Spheres and hemispheres
types.description: Asks for the volume or surface area of a sphere, hemisphere, spherical shell or hemispherical bowl, without melting into another solid.

types.name: Prisms and pyramids
types.description: Asks for the volume, lateral or total surface area of a prism, pyramid or tetrahedron with a triangular, square or hexagonal base.

types.name: Recasting and combined solids
types.description: A solid is melted and recast into others, liquid is poured or flows through a pipe, a solid is dropped into water, or the largest solid is cut from another or two solids are joined.

types.name: Percent change in dimensions
types.description: A length, radius, side or height is increased or decreased by a percent or ratio and the question asks how the area, surface area or volume changes, or compares two similar solids.
